graduation.title: 2026 graduation projects exhibition
graduation.description: The faculty hosted its annual graduation projects exhibition with more than 40 projects in artificial intelligence and data science.
graduation.content:
The faculty hosted its annual graduation projects exhibition for the class of 2026 in a distinguished academic event that brought together students, faculty members, experts, and technology professionals. The exhibition attracted a large number of visitors who came to explore the projects and learn about the innovative solutions developed by the students.

More than 40 graduation projects were presented during the exhibition, covering a wide range of modern technological fields including artificial intelligence, data science, web and mobile application development, Internet of Things, software engineering, data analytics, and cybersecurity.

The projects demonstrated a wide variety of ideas and technologies. Some teams developed machine learning systems capable of analyzing data and predicting future outcomes, while other teams focused on building digital platforms that make services and information more accessible to users.

Several students also presented projects based on Internet of Things technologies, using sensors and smart devices to collect information from the surrounding environment and send it to centralized systems for analysis and decision making. These projects demonstrated the students’ ability to combine hardware and software technologies.

During the exhibition, students presented detailed demonstrations of their projects and explained the development process, technologies, programming tools, and challenges they faced. The teams also answered questions from the jury regarding the purpose, architecture, performance, security, and future development of their solutions.

Members of the judging committee praised the technical and academic quality of many of the projects. They emphasized the importance of transforming theoretical knowledge gained during university studies into practical applications that can potentially solve real-world problems.

The jury also focused on scalability, sustainability, user experience, data security, and system performance. Students received valuable feedback and recommendations that can help them improve their projects and prepare for their professional careers.

The exhibition also included open discussions between students, faculty members, and technology professionals. These discussions covered the future of technology, the skills required by the modern labor market, and the importance of continuous learning after graduation.

The faculty administration emphasized that the graduation projects exhibition is one of the most important annual activities because it gives students the opportunity to demonstrate the knowledge and skills they have acquired throughout their university education.

At the end of the event, several participating teams and students were recognized for their efforts and achievements. The faculty also confirmed its continued support for outstanding student projects and encouraged students to further develop their ideas into practical solutions that can create a positive impact on society and the technology sector.

aiWorkshop.title: Applied AI workshop series starts
aiWorkshop.description: The faculty is running a workshop series on applied artificial intelligence with industry guests.
aiWorkshop.content:
The faculty has launched a specialized workshop series focusing on applied artificial intelligence as part of its efforts to strengthen students’ practical skills and introduce them to the latest technologies used in the technology industry. The initiative is designed to complement academic education with hands-on learning experiences.

The workshops cover a wide range of artificial intelligence topics, starting with the fundamentals of machine learning and data analysis and progressing toward building intelligent models and applying them to real-world problems.

The sessions are delivered by professionals and experts working in the technology industry. They share practical experiences with students and explain how artificial intelligence projects are developed within real companies and what challenges development teams face.

The workshops combine theoretical explanations with practical exercises. Students are given opportunities to implement small projects using modern tools and technologies, helping them understand how to transform an idea into a working solution.

The training program covers topics such as data preparation, data cleaning, exploratory analysis, feature selection, machine learning models, model evaluation, neural networks, and introductory deep learning concepts.

Students are also introduced to practical applications of artificial intelligence in areas such as data analytics, prediction, classification, natural language processing, recommendation systems, and computer vision.

The workshops provide students with opportunities to communicate directly with instructors, ask questions, discuss technical challenges, and work together on practical tasks. Group activities help students improve communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

The organizers emphasized that students need more than theoretical knowledge to succeed in the technology industry. Practical skills such as understanding data, selecting appropriate tools, writing maintainable code, testing solutions, and evaluating results are equally important.

The program also introduces students to different career paths in artificial intelligence, including machine learning engineering, data analysis, data science, artificial intelligence engineering, and data engineering.

The faculty plans to continue organizing specialized workshops and technical events in the future, focusing on emerging technologies and the skills required by students and the modern labor market.

partnership.title: Faculty signs tech partnership agreement
partnership.description: A cooperation agreement covers student training, hiring paths, and curriculum input from partner companies.
partnership.content:
The faculty has signed a strategic partnership agreement with leading technology companies to strengthen cooperation between academic institutions and the technology industry and provide students with new opportunities to prepare for their professional careers.

The agreement reflects the faculty’s commitment to building strong relationships with companies operating in different technology sectors and helping students understand the expectations and requirements of the modern labor market.

The partnership includes practical training opportunities for students during academic semesters and vacation periods. Students will have opportunities to experience real working environments and learn about software development, project management, teamwork, and professional practices.

The agreement also aims to provide training opportunities in modern technologies used by companies, allowing students to gain practical experience that complements the theoretical knowledge they receive through lectures and laboratories.

One of the major areas of cooperation is the continuous development of academic curricula to reflect changes in the technology industry. Industry professionals will contribute their insights to help identify the skills and knowledge graduates will need in the coming years.

The partnership also includes seminars, lectures, and workshops delivered by professionals from technology companies. These activities will introduce students to recent developments in programming, artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and other technology fields.

Students and faculty members will also have opportunities to collaborate on practical projects related to real-world challenges faced by technology companies. Such cooperation can improve students’ problem-solving abilities, creativity, and ability to work on complex technical challenges.

The faculty administration emphasized that cooperation with industry is an essential part of improving education because it helps reduce the gap between academic knowledge and practical skills required by employers.

The agreement is expected to increase training and employment opportunities for students and graduates while also supporting students who have innovative ideas and technical projects.

Representatives of the faculty and participating companies expressed their commitment to expanding the partnership in the future and creating more opportunities that benefit students, graduates, and the technology community.

studentCompetition.title: Students place well in programming contest
studentCompetition.description: A faculty team competed against students from several Egyptian universities.
studentCompetition.content:
A team of faculty students participated in a programming competition that brought together student teams from several Egyptian universities. The teams competed to solve a series of programming problems within a limited amount of time.

The students prepared for the competition through intensive training sessions focusing on algorithms, data structures, problem analysis, and efficient solution design. The team also practiced time management and strategies for dealing with competitive programming environments.

During the competition, students faced a variety of programming challenges that required logical thinking, data analysis, and selecting appropriate algorithms. The team successfully handled several difficult problems and achieved impressive results.

The students explained that participating in the competition helped them identify their strengths and weaknesses and gave them an opportunity to apply concepts learned at university in a real competitive environment.

Teamwork was also an important factor in their performance. Team members divided responsibilities, reviewed possible solutions, discussed ideas, and made decisions under time pressure.

The faculty praised the students’ performance and emphasized that programming competitions play an important role in developing analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and technical confidence.

The faculty continues to encourage students to participate in local and international programming competitions and provides training activities that help them improve their programming and algorithmic skills.

Students were also encouraged to share their experience with colleagues and organize training sessions within the faculty so that more students can benefit from the experience.

The team emphasized that their main goal was not only to achieve a high ranking but also to gain experience, learn from other teams, and discover new approaches to solving complex problems.

The faculty looks forward to achieving more success in upcoming competitions while continuing to support talented students and providing an environment where they can develop their skills.

dataScienceConference.title: Data science conference at the faculty
dataScienceConference.description: Researchers and professionals met to discuss recent work in data science and AI.
dataScienceConference.content:
The faculty organized a specialized conference focusing on data science and artificial intelligence with the participation of researchers, faculty members, and technology professionals. The conference focused on recent developments and applications in the field of data.

The sessions covered several important topics including big data analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data visualization, and the importance of data quality in building intelligent systems.

A number of specialized lectures were delivered by experts who shared their experiences in using data to support decision-making and solve real-world problems across different organizations.

The conference also included discussion sessions addressing challenges faced by organizations when handling large amounts of data, including data quality, privacy, security, and effective data management.

Students had the opportunity to learn about tools and technologies used in the industry and explore different career paths available to graduates interested in data science and artificial intelligence.

Practical applications of data science in healthcare, education, business, commerce, and government services were also presented, demonstrating the growing role of data in improving services and decision-making.

Students actively participated in discussions and asked questions to speakers. These interactions helped clarify technical concepts and provide practical perspectives on challenges in the field.

The faculty administration emphasized that such events help promote a culture of data and artificial intelligence among students and create opportunities for cooperation between researchers and industry professionals.

Participants expressed their interest in future events covering emerging developments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, and digital technologies.

The conference concluded with an emphasis on continued scientific activities and encouraging students to participate in research and practical projects related to data science.

technologyAgreement.title: New student innovation initiative
technologyAgreement.description: The faculty announced support for students with technical project ideas and early startup work.
technologyAgreement.content:
The faculty has announced a new initiative designed to support students with innovative technical ideas and encourage them to transform their concepts into practical projects. The initiative is part of the faculty’s efforts to promote innovation and entrepreneurship among students.

The initiative provides training and consulting opportunities that help students develop their ideas and understand market requirements and customer needs. Students are introduced to the different stages of developing a project, from identifying a problem to creating a prototype.

The program includes workshops covering entrepreneurship, project management, digital marketing, market research, financial planning, and business development. These sessions are delivered by experienced professionals and entrepreneurs.

Students also have opportunities to present their ideas to experts and receive feedback that can help them improve their projects. The evaluation focuses on the practicality of the idea, the problem it solves, and its potential for future development.

The faculty encourages students to form multidisciplinary teams that combine programming, design, data analysis, business, and marketing skills. This approach helps teams create more complete and sustainable projects.

Students are also introduced to different funding opportunities, startup incubators, accelerators, competitions, and programs that support innovative projects.

The faculty emphasized that innovation is not limited to creating new technologies. It also includes using existing technologies in creative ways to solve community problems and improve existing services.

The coming period is expected to include additional activities targeting students interested in technology and entrepreneurship, as well as opportunities to communicate with entrepreneurs and startup founders.

The faculty hopes that the initiative will help discover talented students and encourage them to think creatively and transform academic projects into practical solutions.

The faculty confirmed its continued commitment to supporting students, encouraging innovative ideas, and creating an educational environment that helps students develop their skills and achieve their future goals.
